name: Tavern Cellar
description: A damp cellar beneath The Rusty Cauldron, overrun with rats

cellar.stairs.name: Cellar Stairs
cellar.stairs.description: Rickety wooden stairs descend into the darkness. The musty smell of old ale barrels and something fouler fills the air. Scratching sounds echo from deeper within.

cellar.storage.name: Storage Room
cellar.storage.description: A large storage area filled with barrels, crates, and the stench of rat droppings. Beady eyes glint from the shadows as giant rats scurry between the debris. A crumpled piece of parchment lies in the corner, partially chewed.

examine_checks.success_message: Behind some collapsed barrels, you notice a crude tunnel dug into the stone wall. The stench of chemicals wafts from within.
